independent 2026-07-31, REVISED 2026-07-31 after a reproducibility test. Two independent valuation legs (an earnings multiple against a cash-flow or balance-sheet anchor, never P/E x EV/EBITDA off the same year, which are mechanically linked) plus TWO adversarial audit passes that re-pulled the statements. None of the three passes saw the engine's answer. Re-running the audit showed its categorical flags are NOT reproducible (sound/independent flipped on 9 of 19 names), though its band midpoints are (median drift 3.6%). Admission therefore uses UNION OF CONCERNS - dropped if ANY audit run flagged non-independence - and the band is the envelope of all audit runs intersected with pass 1. That rule is monotone: it can only remove rows, never admit one on a favourable re-roll. band 3250-3900.
